draftText: Our sales team wastes time moving orders from Excel to the CRM. We want to automate it.

fields.title: Automate order transfer from Excel to CRM
fields.context: Sales managers receive orders as Excel files from dealers and re-type them into the CRM by hand.
fields.need: Remove manual re-typing of orders into the CRM.
fields.data: Sample Excel exports (anonymized) and CRM API docs
fields.constraints: Deadline 6 weeks; CRM has a REST API; no access to production data
fields.expectedResult: A script or service that imports orders from Excel into the CRM without manual entry.
fields.successCriteria: Manual entry time cut by 80%; zero duplicate orders.
fields.contact: Head of sales, weekly 30-min call, questions via chat
